strings.(시야에 붉은 색으로 가득한 땅과 함께 멀리 날아가는 텐트를 붙잡으러 뛰: (Red earth fills your view, along with Veled running after a tent blowing away in the distance.)
strings.(나 분명 에스닐에서 누군갈 만나고 있었던 것 같은데….): (I'm sure I was meeting someone in Esnil...)
strings.(오르카리움에서 있었던 일은 기억해. 엘-라르사가 소멸했고, 하르모니아와: (I remember what happened in Orcarium. Ell-Larsa vanished, and Harmonia and Geis took Iris away...)
strings.(그리고 나는 나르샤와 함께 다시 에스닐로 돌아갔는데 왜 여기에 있지?): (Then I returned to Esnil with Narsha. Why am I here?)
No way... Surely not. It can't be.
(Looking exhausted, Veled lies collapsed in the tent's entrance with only his face sticking out.)
strings.(벨레드가 %s의 눈과 마주치자 짐짓 놀라 뒤로 물러난다.): (When his eyes meet %s's, Veled startles and retreats.)
If you've come to hear about beauty, you're welcome.
Oh... That's not why I'm here.
Come to think of it, you...
You don't seem to be the you I know.
strings.말로 설명하기 힘들어. 네 영혼은 하나인데, 또 하나가 더 있는 것 같아: It's hard to explain. You have one soul, but it feels like there's another one too. Oh, even I don't know what I'm saying.
strings.(잘은 모르겠지만, 다른 시공간의 나…. 그런 걸까?): (I'm not sure, but... A me from another time and space? Is that it?)
strings.그런데, 벨레드. 마을 안에 있어야 하지 않아요?: But Veled, shouldn't you be inside the village?
strings.거기도 좋지만, 여기도 좋아. 아름다운 성이 잘 있나 지켜봐야지. 안 그: It's nice there, but I like it here too. I need to watch over the beautiful castle. Though the wind keeps blowing my tent away...
strings.그러고보니 여기 온 이유를 안 물어봤네. 무슨 일이야?: Come to think of it, I haven't asked why you're here. What's going on?
I don't know. I suddenly came to my senses here...
strings.무슨 일이 있었는지 알려줄래?: Can you tell me what happened?
strings.(오르카리움에서 있었던 일부터 에스닐에서 누군가를 만나고 있었던 것까지만: (You explain that you remember what happened in Orcarium and meeting someone in Esnil, but nothing beyond that.)
strings.여신님에게 그런 일이 있었단 말이지. 그래도 정령들이 데려갔으니 괜찮을: So that happened to the goddess. Still, the spirits took her away, so I think she'll be all right...
strings.아무래도 너는 직접적으로 여신님과 연결된 사람이니까 어떻게든 영향을 받았: You're directly connected to the goddess, so you must have been affected somehow.
I'll help you. But you'll have to find an object...
Probably the one that caused this situation.
strings.이리스가 상처입어서 이렇게 된 상황이 아니고요?: So this isn't because Iris was injured?
strings.물건을 찾아오면 이야기해줄게. 그리고 내게 다시 올때까지 에스닐이란 곳에: Bring me the object, and I'll explain. And don't go to Esnil until you return to me. We don't know what might happen...
It just makes me a little uneasy.
strings.알았어요. 그러면 어디서 찾죠?: All right. Where should I look?
strings.마족의 힘이 강하게 남겨진 장소. 나 생각한 곳은 나락의 방하고 로젠가르: Somewhere with strong traces of demonic power. I was thinking of the Abyss Chamber and Rosengarten... Could you try the Abyss Chamber first?
Don't worry about Rosengarten. I'll prepare to open its reverse side. If you find the object in the Abyss Chamber, I can simply close it again.
With power similar to Asmodea's, I might be able to recreate it. Though not for very long.
Will you be all right? It could be dangerous.
strings.그건 그렇고, 나락의 방에 가기 전에 먼저 거기 주인에게 가봐. 입장 허: Before you enter the Abyss Chamber, visit its owner. You'll need permission.
Shynic? Has something happened to the Abyss Chamber...?
strings.발드릭이 나락의 방에 몰려든 악마들을 잡고 싶다고 해서 들어갔는데, 간만: Valdrick went in because he wanted to hunt the devils gathering there. Apparently he had fun for the first time in a while.
The ruler of Tartarus ran all the way here...
strings.바보 곰탱이 때문에 나락의 방이 다 부서졌어!!, 귀찮아 죽겠는데, 왜: Shouting, 'That stupid bear wrecked the whole Abyss Chamber!! Everything's enough of a bother already! Why make me do all these annoying repairs?!' Then she left.
I know she isn't an ordinary person, so she was really frightening...
Someone who hates troublesome work must be doing a lot of it now...
I'll go for now. Sigh... There must be some way once I get there.
strings.재미있는 일도 아닌데, 귀찮은 일이 잔뜩이야♡: Nothing fun, just piles of annoying work. ♡
strings.(웃는 얼굴의 샤이닉 주위에 알 수 없는 어둠이 몰려있다.): (An unknown darkness gathers around the smiling Shynic.)
The ground seems to be shaking...
You can think of it as Shynic's mood while she repairs the Abyss Chamber.
strings.(샤이닉이 모험가를 알아보자마자 타르타로스 전체의 흔들림이 사라진다.): (The moment Shynic recognizes the adventurer, the shaking throughout Tartarus stops.)
strings.무슨 일로 왔어? 재미있는 일이야? 응?: What brings you here? Something fun? Hm?
I need to enter the Abyss Chamber. As for why...
strings.(오르카리움에서 있었던 일부터 갑자기 포보스에게 오게 된 것까지 간단하게: (You briefly explain what happened in Orcarium and how you suddenly arrived in Phobos.)
strings.아, 그건 아닌 것 같은데…. 페르세의 꿈이면 내가 인식하지 못할리 없잖: Oh, no, that doesn't seem right... If it were Perse's dream, there's no way I wouldn't recognize it...
strings.%s 님, 샤이닉 님께서 나락 가시랍니다! 아니, 나락의 방 가시랍니다!: %s, Shynic says you may go to the abyss! I mean, the Abyss Chamber!
strings.(어, 그런데 샤이닉 님의 표정이 살짝 바뀐 것 같은데….): (Huh? Shynic's expression seems to have changed a little...)
strings.대신, 갔다가 나한테 다시 오는 거야. 알았지?: But come back to me afterward. Understood?
strings.뭐해? 안가고? 당장 가. 안 가면 죽을 지도 몰라♡: What are you doing? Aren't you going? Go right now. If you don't, you might die. ♡
What? Oh, right. I'll go now.
strings.(멜빅이 모험가를 배웅하고 돌아오자 샤이닉이 바닥에 엎어져 있다.): (When Melvic returns after seeing the adventurer off, Shynic is sprawled on the floor.)
Shynic, you've died of inconvenience already.
strings.%s에게 아무 말도 안했지?: You didn't tell %s anything, did you?
I recreated Malphas and put him inside. How convenient that I can test him now.
Though I don't know what %s will think.
strings.재미있었어? 재미있었지?: Was it fun? It was fun, wasn't it?
If you made it through all right...
strings.나락의 방 난이도를 더 올려도 될 것 같네? 언젠가는 제대로 된 나락의: Then I suppose I can raise the Abyss Chamber's difficulty further. Someday I'll throw you into a proper abyssal pit. ♡
strings.그런데, 찾는 건 있었어?: But did you find what you were looking for?
strings.뭔가 나왔으면 내가 먼저 발견했겠지. 나온 거라곤 발드릭이 먹고 버린 고: If something had appeared, I would have found it first. All I found was a box of bones from the meat Valdrick ate.
strings.포보스까지 뛰어가서 물어보니까 뼈 담은 상자 가지고 나오는 걸 까먹었다고: I ran to Phobos and asked him. He said he'd forgotten to bring the box of bones out.
I thought dealing with that stupid bear would only be more trouble, so I left it.
strings.여기서 못 구했다면 마족이 있었던 곳을 더 찾아봐야겠네? 로젠가르텐이라…: If you didn't find it here, you'll have to search more places where demons have been. Rosengarten...
I'd like to go with you, but it seems the person involved has to find this object.
It can't be helped. Thank you for offering, anyway.
It smells like a witch, but it isn't a witch.
Even after living this long, I can't know everything in the world.
It's a shame I can't help.
It's all right. I'll go see Veled, then. Goodbye.
It was nice to see you after so long. Come play again.
strings.제가 잘 다녀왔다고 하니까 샤이닉 님이 나락의 방을 더 어렵게 만들어보겠: When I said I'd made it through safely, Shynic said she would make it harder.
strings.사악하기로는 악마 못지 않은 걸. 뭔가 들고 온건 없는 거지?: She's as wicked as any devil. So you didn't bring anything?
strings.그러면 이번엔 로젠가르텐이야. 나 네가 나락의 방에 다녀오는 동안 로젠가: Then Rosengarten is next. While you were at the Abyss Chamber, I created Rosengarten's reverse side.
strings.이면을 만들어도 괜찮은 거예요?: Are you all right after creating it?
Yes. I rested a little, and I'm fine. This much is...
strings.별 건 아닌데, 신경 쓰이는 게 있어. 마계의 흔적을 찾기 위해 이면을: It's nothing much, but something bothers me. If you wander the reverse side searching for traces of the Demon Realm...
strings.모습을 드러내지 않던 존재들이 반응할 수 있어. 마족이라던가, 마녀라던가: Beings that have remained hidden may react. Demons, witches...
Then perhaps the reason I came here and met you...
strings.마녀가 장난을 치는 것과는 다른 형태. 마치 자신을 찾아달라고 하는 것: It's different from a witch playing tricks. It almost seems to be asking you to find it.
strings.나 그걸 알고 싶어서 %s에게 물건을 찾아오라고 한 거야. 마족의 물건이: I wanted to understand that, so I asked you to find the object, %s. If it belongs to a demon, I'll recognize it.
strings.같이 가고 싶지만, 내가 거기 가면 이상해질 것 같아서 여기서 좀 쉬고: I'd like to come along, but things might get strange if I enter. I'll rest here.
strings.(로젠가르텐의 이면을 한참동안 헤매다 바닥에 떨어진 검은색 물건을 발견한: (After wandering Rosengarten's reverse side for some time, you find a black object on the ground.)
A black crescent moon... It doesn't suit this red rose garden.
strings.누군가 나보고 가져가라고 일부러 놔둔 것 같아…: It feels as though someone deliberately left it for me to take...
Sigh. Then I suppose I have to take it.
strings.(벨레드가 %s에게서 검은 달 펜던트를 받아들고 유심히 지켜본다.): (Veled receives the Black Moon Pendant from %s and examines it closely.)
It seems broken, but it's still holding its shape...
strings.네 말대로 일부러 가져가라고 그 자리에 놓은 것 같아. 네가 원래의 자리: As you said, it seems to have been placed there for you to take. To return where you belong, you must destroy it without a trace.
I hope that will be the end of it...
strings.(금방이라도 부서질 것 같은 검은 달 펜던트지만, %s의 힘으로는 깨지지: (The Black Moon Pendant looks ready to crumble, but %s's strength cannot break it.)
Let me try. Most weak beings suffer mental collapse at my hands...
strings.(벨레드가 붙잡아둔 하급 악마를 향해 손을 뻗는다. 그러자 하급 악마가: (Veled reaches toward a captured lesser devil. It curses him as it vanishes.)
strings.(…벨레드의 힘이 아스모데아의 것과 같다고 했으니 이 정도는 쉬운 건가…: (...He said his power is the same as Asmodea's. Is this much easy for him...?)
strings.(벨레드가 검은 달 펜던트을 향해 손을 뻗지만, 깨지지 않는다.): (Veled reaches toward the Black Moon Pendant, but it does not break.)
It doesn't react to my devil's power or to yours as a follower of a god.
It is another kind of power, but not an ordinary one. For example...
A god with power greater than the goddess's...
Power that can effortlessly disregard time and space...
strings.나 널 보고 다른 사람 같다고 한 건, 이게 여기에 떨어지면서 그렇게 됐: When I said you seemed like someone else, perhaps it was because this had fallen here.
strings.그런데 벨레드는 그런 저를 어떻게 인식한 거죠?: But how were you able to recognize me like this?
strings.나 아스모데아의 힘이 바이스가 만든 마석과 만나고, 마녀의 손길로 눈을: I'm different from ordinary beings. Asmodea's power met the magic stone Vice made, and a witch's touch awakened me...
strings.그렇지 않으면 넌 계속 다른 시간과 공간 사이에서 머물게 될 거야. 여신: Otherwise, you'll remain between different times and spaces. You may never meet the goddess again...
If you return to Esnil, where you were meeting someone, without destroying it...
Whatever the owner of this Black Moon Pendant wants will happen.
strings.이건 아스모데아의 지식인 것 같아. 마계에서 몽마들과 함께 오랜 시간을: I think this knowledge comes from Asmodea. I knew she was wise, having lived so long with the succubi in the Demon Realm...
strings.이번 일을 해결한다 해도, 이런 일을 벌인 존재가 또 같은 일을 하지 않: Even if we resolve this, there's no guarantee the being behind it won't do the same thing again...
Still, we should get you out of this situation first.
strings.그런데 이상한 건 말이지. 펜던트 주인의 힘이 너에게만 걸려 있다는 거야: But something is strange. The pendant's owner's power affects only you. Shouldn't the ruler of Tartarus and I actually be unable to recognize you?
Is that so...? I don't know. Hmm...
If we could learn something connected to time and space, there might be a way...
strings.괜찮은 방법이 떠오른 거야?: Have you thought of a good approach?
There's a place with many spirits that influence time, space, and emotion.
Then go there. There must be a way. Here, take this.
Thank you, Veled. I'll find a way and come back.
strings.방법을 찾으면 어차피 나나 너나 이 상황을 기억하지 못할 거야. 뭔가 씌: If you find a way, neither you nor I will remember this situation anyway. Like something laid over us has disappeared.
strings.나중에 아름다움에 대해 듣는 거다. 알았지?: Next time, you'll listen to me talk about beauty. Understood?
strings.보통 인간에겐 아름다움은 중요하지 않은 걸까?: Is beauty unimportant to ordinary humans?
I forgot to close Rosengarten's reverse side, and you came out through it...
You. You can't be here for a serious discussion of beauty.
My sister asked me to come see the doll.
I was thinking about something and didn't notice you arrive. Welcome, adventurer.
strings.다른 시공간의 영향을 받으신 상태로 이곳에 오셨군요. 프뉴마의 정령들에게: You've come here while under the influence of another time and space. It won't greatly affect Pneuma's spirits, but just in case...
strings.(아르케가 예전에 사용했던 개다래나무 향수를 뿌려준다.): (Arche sprays you with the silvervine perfume she used before.)
I'm sorry, Arche. The reason I came like this...
strings.%s 님에게 어떤 일이 있었던 거겠죠. 괜찮아요. 제 도움이 필요하신 거: Something must have happened to you, %s. It's all right. You need my help, correct?
It's a long story, but I'll tell you.
strings.(아르케에게 오르카리움에서 있었던 일부터 프뉴마에 오게 된 과정을 모두: (You tell Arche everything, from what happened in Orcarium to how you came to Pneuma.)
strings.엘-라르사…라는 정령이 그렇게 삶을 마감했군요. 저는 만나본 적은 없지만: So that is how the spirit called Ell-Larsa reached the end of his life. I never met him, but...
strings.프뉴마에 있던 정령들이 어느 순간 한 곳을 바라본 적이 있었는데, 그때: At one point, the spirits in Pneuma all looked in one direction. A small light passed through Pneuma then.
strings.이리스 님이 %s 님을 구한 건 후회하지 않는 선택을 만들기 위해서 그랬: Lady Iris saved you, %s, because she wanted to make a choice she would not regret. So please don't worry too much.
strings.아, 프뉴마의 정령들은 괜찮아요?: Oh, are Pneuma's spirits all right?
strings.괜찮은 것 같아요. 저는 정령이 아니기에 정령이 가진 생각과 감정을 제대: They seem to be. I am not a spirit, so I can't fully understand their thoughts and feelings. Still, they must all have felt lonely...
Let's leave that for now. Go see Kairos.
strings.아마도 이리스 님과 연결되어 있는 모험가님의 시간, 그 시간의 특별한 순: I think someone interfered with a special moment in your time, which is connected to Lady Iris, and Kairos is sensing something troubling.
strings.아르케도 알고 있는 존재인가요?: Is it a being you know too, Arche?
strings.저는 잘 몰라요. 제가 아는 신은 가이아 님과 이리스 님이 전부에요. 프: I don't know. The only gods I know are Lady Gaia and Lady Iris, who are connected to Pneuma...
strings.카이로스나 크로노스가 저보다 더 오래 살아서 알고 있는 게 많겠지만, 정: Kairos and Chronos have lived longer than I have and must know more, but as spirits, they cannot defy providence.
strings.모험가님이 오르카리움에서 보셨던 이리스 님과 엘-라르사를 생각하시면 돼요: Think of Lady Iris and Ell-Larsa, whom you saw in Orcarium.
strings.(이야기를 들으면 들을수록 점점 더 복잡해져. 그 노인이 이 세계에 또: (The more I hear, the more complicated it gets. Did that old man send someone else into this world?)
strings.(카이로스가 놀랐는지 털이 잔뜩 서 있는 상태였지만, %s의 모습을 확인: (Kairos's fur stands on end in surprise, but settles again after recognizing %s.)
You startled me. I'd only just fallen asleep when you appeared...
strings.괜찮아. 그런데 무슨 일…. 킁킁…. 향수 냄새가 나는 걸 보니 아르케: It's all right. What brings you... Sniff, sniff... I smell perfume. You've been to Arche.
And you've been affected by another power...
It's all right. You don't have to explain.
The goddess is all right now, so you don't need to worry too much.
I can't tell you about that. Sorry. I'm a spirit...
It's a spirit's wing that flew here from Orca's land. It's badly broken.
strings.오르카의 땅에서 있었던 일에 그 힘이 개입하면서 이게 버티지 못하고 내: When that power interfered with what happened in Orca's land, this couldn't withstand it and flew into my domain.
strings.네 시간의 일부를 기억하는 물건이니까, 이거라면 네가 돌아갈 시간으로 인: It remembers part of your time. Perhaps it can guide you back to the time where you belong.
strings.그런데 정말 프뉴마는 괜찮은 거야?: But is Pneuma really all right?
strings.괜찮아. 그냥 영향을 조금 받을 뿐. 여기는 무너지지 않아. 여기가 무너: It's fine. It's only affected a little. This place won't collapse. If it did, every world would be in danger, so even the Twisted One leaves it alone.
strings.아, 이제 좀 잘 수 있게 됐당. 이 물건은 네가 아니면 여기 밖으로 뺄: Oh, now I can finally sleep. No one but you could take that object out of here.
Oh, I see. Thank you, Kairos.
strings.(카이로스가 말이 끝나기가 무섭게 그대로 엎드려 잠을 청한다.): (No sooner has Kairos finished speaking than he lies down to sleep.)
Somehow, I'm sleepy too. Yawn... This isn't the time. Let's hurry.
strings.카이로스는 잘 만나고 오셨어요?: Did you have a good talk with Kairos?
strings.네, 카이로스는 이걸 주고서 편하게 자고 있어요. 아르케, 이거 뭔지 아: Yes. He gave me this and is sleeping comfortably now. Arche, do you know what it is?
This is a spirit's wing. It seems to have fallen from a spirit that lost the light of life.
Kairos said it came to Pneuma remembering part of my time. He told me to give it to you.
strings.(아르케가 정령의 날개를 받아들고선 전혀 모르겠다는 표정을 짓는다.): (Arche holds the spirit's wing with an expression of complete uncertainty.)
strings.(아르케 표정을 보니 비밀은 아닌 것 같은데…. 어?): (From her face, it doesn't seem to be a secret... Huh?)
(A faint cracking sound comes from the Black Moon Pendant in %s's hand. But it only cracks slightly and does not break completely.)
strings.정령의 날개 때문에 검은 달 펜던트가 이렇게 된 것 같은데…. 왜 여기서: The spirit's wing seems to have done this to the pendant... Why did it stop?
strings.검은 달의 힘이 정령의 날개에서 퍼져 나오는 힘보다 더 강하기 때문이에요: Because the black moon's power is stronger than the power spreading from the spirit's wing.
It was thanks to Lady Iris that the pendant could crack even this much.
Lady Iris sent this spirit's wing. To protect you...
strings.달과 꽃, 초목의 주인이 되신 이리스 님이 이 별에 계시는 동안엔 언제나: As long as Lady Iris, who became mistress of the moon, flowers, and plants, remains on this star, a bright and beautiful moon will always rise...
But otherwise, it will become a bleak black moon.
strings.잠깐만요. 달의 주인은 이리스 하난데, 그런 존재가 더 있다는 건가요?: Wait. Iris is the only mistress of the moon. Are you saying there is another being like that?
strings.가이아 님께서 대지 위에 일부인 초목을 세레스 님께 나눠주신 것처럼, 달: Just as Lady Gaia shared the plants, part of her earth, with Lady Seres, perhaps the moon never belonged to Lady Seres alone.
I don't know the affairs of the ancient gods, but if that's true... Oh, this is complicated...
Honestly, it's complicated for me too. I'm barely managing to organize what the spirits tell me...
When that being reveals itself, its name will become known. But not yet.
strings.이리스가 도와서 겨우 반쯤 파괴할 수 있었는데, 나머지 반은 어떻게 해야: Even with Iris's help, we could only half destroy it. What do we do about the rest...? We'd need equally powerful energy...
strings.이 정령의 날개는 오르카리움에서 왔으니 그곳을 한 번 더 찾아볼까요?: This spirit's wing came from Orcarium. Should I search there again?
strings.(아르케가 %s의 말을 듣자 주위를 향해 팔을 벌린다. 그러자 어디선가: (At %s's suggestion, Arche spreads her arms. Spirits approach from somewhere and whisper to her in incomprehensible sounds.)
The spirits say that's a good idea.
strings.지금 모험가님은 오르카리움을 다녀오신 후에 다른 시공간에 계신 거니까…,: Since you are in another time and space after visiting Orcarium... Orcarium must still exist in some form.
strings.검은 달 펜던트처럼 내가 오길 기다리고 있는 물건이 있을 수도 있겠네요…: There might be an object waiting for me to come, like the Black Moon Pendant...
strings.그 물건을 찾으셨다면 다시 이곳으로 오세요. 프뉴마는 어떤 곳보다 안전한: If you find it, come back here. Pneuma is safer than anywhere else.
strings.알았어요, 아르케. 다른 곳으로 가지 않고 바로 프뉴마로 올게요. 그러면: All right, Arche. I won't go anywhere else. I'll come straight to Pneuma. See you later.
strings.(생명의 엔텔레케를 헤매던 중, 특이한 느낌으로 빛나고 있는 작은 돌조각: (While wandering the Enteleche of Life, you find a small stone fragment glowing with a peculiar light.)
strings.(엘-라르사를 만났던 장소 뒤쪽으로 한때는 정령이 사랑했던 나무들이 보: (Behind the place where you met Ell-Larsa stand trees the spirit once loved. Among the stumps, whose rings hold long years, you see a small orb of light.)
This is the light that circled Ell-Larsa... I can feel its powerful energy.
When I went there, as you suggested, I found objects with powerful energy.
But it felt different from when I went with Narsha.
Because it is another time and space... Perhaps even a reverse side.
strings.(아르케의 손에 검은 달 펜던트와 빛의 근원, 그리고 엔텔레케의 파편이: (The Black Moon Pendant, the Source of Light, and the Enteleche Fragment gather in Arche's hands. The latter two turn into brilliant light and begin wrapping around the pendant.)
strings.정령이 가진 순수한 힘이 느껴져요. 엘-라르사를 비롯해 오르카리움에 머물: I can feel the pure power of spirits. The light of Ell-Larsa and the others who dwelled in Orcarium...
strings.(빛이 점점 커지고 갈라진 검은 달 펜던트 사이로 들어간다. 잠시 후,: (The light grows and enters the cracks in the Black Moon Pendant. Soon, the pendant trembles and gradually crumbles into powder.)
Not yet. This powder cannot remain here.
strings.(아르케가 하늘을 향해 손을 뻗자 빛나는 모래처럼 변한 가루가 바람을 타: (Arche reaches toward the sky, and the powder, now like glittering sand, rides the wind away.)
Now you can return to your original timeline.
strings.어, 그런데 어떻게 돌아가죠?: Oh, but how do I get back?
Close your eyes, and the spirits will guide you to your original time.
strings.고마워요. 아르케. 그런데 하늘에서 떨어지고 그런 건 아니죠?: Thank you, Arche. I won't fall out of the sky or anything, right?
strings.모험가님은 이제 원래의 시공간으로 돌아가실 거예요. 검은 달의 영향으로: You will now return to your original time and space. The memories formed under the black moon's influence will disappear.
strings.모험가님이 만났던 분들도 기억하지 못하셔야 정상이지만, 벨레드 님이나 샤: Normally, the people you met should not remember either, but beings like Veled and Shynic...
Let's leave them out. They aren't ordinary beings.
strings.원래의 기억을 마주보게 되는 순간, 잠깐 어지러울 수 있어요…. 저도 그: When you face your original memories, you may feel dizzy for a moment... I did too.
strings.그때 그랬어요?: Is that what happened to you then?
Yes, something similar. I'm telling you just in case.
strings.(따뜻한 솜? 구름? 아에루라였나? 푹신푹신해서 이대로 잠이 들것 같아…: (Warm cotton? Clouds? Was it an Aerura? It's so soft I could fall asleep like this...)
strings.(고개를 들자 파란색 눈동자가 보석처럼 빛나는 여성이 인자한 미소를 짓고: (You raise your head to see a woman with blue eyes shining like jewels and a kindly smile.)
strings.(뭐지, 이 나른한 기분은…? 내가 잠시 어디 다녀왔나?….): (What is this drowsy feeling...? Did I go somewhere for a while...?)
strings.(그런데 저분은 누구시지? 후광이 비치는 것처럼 아름다운 분이시네…. 태: (But who is she? She's so beautiful it's as though a halo shines around her... She's wearing a sun-shaped tiara...)
strings.(여성이 갑자기 %s의 두 손을 덥썩 붙잡는다.): (The woman suddenly takes both of %s's hands.)
strings.만나뵙고 싶었는데, 그동안 기회가 없었네요. 저도 그렇고 %s 님도 바빴: I've wanted to meet you, but never had the chance. Both you and I have been busy, %s.
Honestly, what is my silly sister doing...
strings.저는 카이나 던 실바리아…, 데이나의 언니 되는 사람이에요. 그동안 동생: I am Kaina Dawn Silvaria... Dayna's older sister. Thank you for helping my younger sisters so much.
It's a pleasure to meet you too. But if you're Dayna's older sister...
strings.실바리아 제국 황제 폐하?!: Her Majesty, Empress of the Silvaria Empire?!
strings.(어, 잠깐…. 기시감이 드는데…, 내가 폐하를 만난 적이 있던가? 그건: (Wait... This feels familiar. Have I met Her Majesty before? No, I haven't...)
strings.(미소짓고 있던 카이나의 표정이 순간 다른 느낌으로 빠르게 지나간다.): (For an instant, a different expression flashes across Kaina's smiling face.)
If you stand there so dazed, you might fall into the Sea of Emptiness. Hehe.
There is something I'd like to tell you.
About the new witch who will soon appear...
